name: Outro
_source: s;Mui;You went out cold after knocking Master Luo out of his frenzy state.|Thanks to you, I've safely gotten the Elixir and gave it to my brother.|{c:e;Mui;Smile}He's made a full recovery.
s;Shen;Oh, good.{c:wait;400} So that was worth it then.|And where are our UNION pals?{c:wait;400} I have some questions to ask them.
s;Andy;I'm convinced, you have complete control over your negation, Untruth.|Feng was involved in it, wasn't he?

s;Shen;...Yes, it's been a decade since Untruth manifested.{c:wait;200} Master Feng left on that day.|I've practiced my negation to become the edge that help me defeat him,|that is if he hasn't become senile already.
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko,{c:wait;400} you said that UNION is an ally to all Negators.|I can tell that both you and Mr. Andy are Negators as well.|Then are you here to recruit Master Shen?
s;Fuuko;Not just him.{c:wait;400} We are here for both of you.|Mui, our friendship goes a long way back after all.
s;Mui;I-I don't get it. But I'd love to have a chance to help you back.
s;Andy;Then all that's left is your answer, Shen.

s;Shen;I don't know when, but I had forgotten it.{c:wait;400} That fight has helped jog my memory.|I get stronger for other people's sake. I get stronger for them, and they for me.|For my sister, for my master,{c:wait;400}{c:mirror;Shen} and for you, Mui.|I'm sure that this feeling...{c:wait;400} this emotion...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;Smile}{c:bop;Shen;no_block} This is the truth behind becoming the strongest.|Let's get stronger, together this time.
s;Fuuko;We are glad to have you two!
s;Shen;And by the way, Mr. Andy, was it?|{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes,Smile}I remember a myth about an immortal fighter with the same name.|I sure would love to square off against you one day.
s;Luo;Thanks for stopping me, Shen.|I'm ashamed that you have to witness me in that frenzy state.
s;Shen;Zip it. All I'm interested in is his whereabout.
s;Luo;Right, straight to business...|The truth is, Master Feng has joined a group of individuals with special ability.|Their name?
